# Feature reference

<!-- Generated by tools/docgen. Do not edit. -->

Every event stores these bucketed features (never raw signals). Rules address them as `group.name`. Unknown values are NaN or empty and never fire a rule. "Model" marks features the learned model may use.

## Privacy profile (informational, never risk)

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prof.rfp` | bool |  | Firefox resistFingerprinting or Tor Browser detected; fingerprint-consistency rules are gated off |
| `prof.brave` | bool |  | Brave Shields farbling detected; canvas/audio/WebGL consistency rules are gated off |
| `prof.tor` | bool |  | Tor Browser specifically (subset of rfp) |
| `prof.dnt` | bool |  | Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control set; never a risk signal |
| `prof.forced_colors` | bool |  | forced-colors: active (accessibility hint); never a risk signal |

## Automation markers

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auto.wd` | bucket: false, true, undefined/missing | yes | navigator.webdriver state |
| `auto.wd_tamper` | bool | yes | navigator.webdriver getter tampered (missing descriptor, non-native toString, realm mismatch) |
| `auto.cdp` | bool | yes | CDP Runtime.enable artefact observed (stack/console serialisation probe fired) |
| `auto.leaks` | count | yes | Count of known automation globals present (cdc_, __playwright, __puppeteer, ...) |
| `auto.headless_ua` | bool | yes | HeadlessChrome in UA or userAgentData brands |
| `auto.outer_zero` | bool | yes | outerWidth or outerHeight is 0 |
| `auto.outer_eq_inner` | bool | yes | outer == inner on a desktop UA with no fullscreen element |
| `auto.default_viewport` | bool | yes | 800x600 viewport at DPR 1 (framework default) |
| `auto.plugins` | count | yes | navigator.plugins.length |
| `auto.plugins_shape` | bucket: native-expected, empty, non-native-prototype, inconsistent | yes | PluginArray shape class |
| `auto.lang_count` | count | yes | navigator.languages length |
| `auto.chrome_obj` | bucket: n/a (non-chromium UA), present-native, missing, present-fake | yes | window.chrome object shape class |
| `auto.notif_contradiction` | bool | yes | Notification.permission denied while permissions.query says prompt |
| `auto.conn_rtt_zero` | bool | yes | navigator.connection.rtt === 0 (emulated network) |
| `auto.voices` | bucket: n/a, 0, 1-5, 6+ | yes | speechSynthesis voices count bucket |
| `auto.eng` | cat: v8, spidermonkey, jsc, other | yes | JS engine class from error-message and eval probes |
| `auto.non_native_apis` | count | yes | Count of core APIs (fetch, Promise, crypto.subtle, TextEncoder, ...) whose toString is not native code |

## Fingerprint consistency

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fp.ua_family` | cat: chrome, edge, firefox, safari, opera, samsung, brave, other, none | yes | Browser family parsed from navigator.userAgent |
| `fp.ua_major` | count | yes | Browser major version |
| `fp.os_family` | cat: windows, macos, ios, android, linux, chromeos, other | yes | OS family parsed from navigator.userAgent |
| `fp.ua_mobile` | bool | yes | UA claims a mobile device |
| `fp.feat_mismatch` | count | yes | Count of feature probes inconsistent with the claimed browser major version |
| `fp.uad_mismatch` | bool | yes | navigator.userAgentData disagrees with the UA string |
| `fp.mobile_no_touch` | bool | yes | Mobile UA with maxTouchPoints 0 and wide screen |
| `fp.desktop_coarse_pointer` | bool | yes | Desktop Chrome UA with coarse pointer and no touch points (device emulation) |
| `fp.screen_w_bucket` | bucket | yes | screen.width in 160 px buckets |
| `fp.dpr_bucket` | bucket | yes | devicePixelRatio in 0.25 steps |
| `fp.avail_eq_screen` | bool | yes | availHeight == height on a claimed Windows desktop (no taskbar) |
| `fp.tz_offset_mismatch` | bool | yes | Intl timezone id disagrees with Date.getTimezoneOffset |
| `fp.tz_utc` | bool | yes | Timezone is UTC/Etc |
| `fp.tz_country` | cat | yes | Country derived from the timezone id (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase) |
| `fp.lang_primary` | cat | yes | Primary language subtag from navigator.languages (lowercase) |
| `fp.gpu_class` | cat: hardware, software, blocked, none, other | yes | WebGL renderer class (software = SwiftShader/llvmpipe/Mesa offscreen) |
| `fp.gpu_os_mismatch` | bool | yes | WebGL renderer vendor family impossible for the claimed OS |
| `fp.canvas_blocked` | bool | yes | Canvas returned blank (blocked or RFP) |
| `fp.canvas_known_headless` | bool | yes | Canvas hash matches a known software-renderer hash |
| `fp.audio_present` | bool | yes | Audio fingerprint computed |
| `fp.font_os_class` | cat: windows, macos, android, linux-desktop, linux-bare, mixed, none, other | yes | OS class inferred from the font presence bitmask |
| `fp.font_os_mismatch` | bool | yes | Font OS class contradicts the claimed OS |
| `fp.hc_bucket` | bucket: 1-2, 3-4, 5-8, 9-16, 17+ | yes | hardwareConcurrency bucket |
| `fp.dm_bucket` | bucket: <=2, 4, 8, >=16 | yes | deviceMemory bucket (Chromium only) |
| `fp.touch_points` | count | yes | navigator.maxTouchPoints |
| `fp.pointer_class` | bucket: none, fine, coarse, both | yes | pointer/any-pointer media query class |
| `fp.color_scheme_dark` | bool | yes | prefers-color-scheme: dark |
| `fp.reduced_motion` | bool |  | prefers-reduced-motion: reduce |

## Behaviour (aggregates only)

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `beh.total_events` | count | yes | Total trusted input events observed |
| `beh.ptr_samples` | count | yes | Pointer move samples |
| `beh.ptr_path_len` | float | yes | Total pointer path length (px) |
| `beh.ptr_straightness` | float | yes | Displacement / path length (1 = perfectly straight) |
| `beh.ptr_speed_cv` | float | yes | Coefficient of variation of pointer speed |
| `beh.ptr_dir_changes` | count | yes | Direction changes along the pointer path |
| `beh.ptr_accel_flips` | count | yes | Acceleration sign changes |
| `beh.ptr_interval_cv` | float | yes | Coefficient of variation of inter-sample intervals |
| `beh.ptr_collinear_frac` | float | yes | Fraction of consecutive triples that are exactly collinear |
| `beh.untrusted_frac` | float | yes | Fraction of input events with isTrusted === false |
| `beh.click_count` | count | yes | Pointer down/up pairs |
| `beh.click_dur_mean` | float | yes | Mean press duration (ms) |
| `beh.click_dur_cv` | float | yes | CV of press duration |
| `beh.click_center_frac` | float | yes | Fraction of clicks landing within 1 px of the element centre |
| `beh.click_no_move` | bool | yes | A click occurred with no pointer movement observed beforehand |
| `beh.key_count` | count | yes | Key down events |
| `beh.key_hold_mean` | float | yes | Mean keydown to keyup (ms) |
| `beh.key_hold_cv` | float | yes | CV of key hold time |
| `beh.key_interval_cv` | float | yes | CV of inter-key interval |
| `beh.key_backspace_frac` | float | yes | Backspace share of key events |
| `beh.input_no_key_frac` | float | yes | Fraction of changed fields that received input without any keydown (fill/autofill) |
| `beh.paste_count` | count | yes | Paste events |
| `beh.scroll_count` | count | yes | Scroll/wheel events |
| `beh.wheel_class` | bucket: none, mouse (120 multiples), trackpad (small floats), exact-round-other | yes | Wheel delta quantisation class |
| `beh.focus_start` | bool | yes | document.hasFocus() at snippet start |
| `beh.focus_submit` | bool | yes | document.hasFocus() at submit |
| `beh.visibility_changes` | count | yes | visibilitychange/blur/focus events |
| `beh.hidden_at_submit` | bool | yes | document.visibilityState hidden at submit |
| `beh.raf_median` | float | yes | Median requestAnimationFrame interval (ms) |
| `beh.raf_cv` | float | yes | CV of rAF interval (0 = synthetic flat clock) |

## Environment

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `env.perm_all_prompt` | bool | yes | Every queried permission is in prompt state (fresh context) |
| `env.perm_granted_count` | count | yes | Permissions in granted state |
| `env.storage_ok` | bool | yes | localStorage write/read round-trip succeeded |
| `env.storage_throws` | bool | yes | A storage API threw |
| `env.cookies` | bool | yes | navigator.cookieEnabled |
| `env.quota_bucket` | bucket: n/a, <1GB (incognito-like), 1-10GB, >10GB | yes | storage.estimate().quota bucket |
| `env.timer_precision` | bucket: fine, coarse (RFP 100ms), unknown | yes | performance.now precision class |
| `env.dom_ready_bucket` | bucket: <50ms, 50-200, 200-1000, 1-5s, >5s | yes | domContentLoadedEventEnd - fetchStart |
| `env.resources_bucket` | bucket: 0, 1-5, 6-30, 31+ | yes | Resource timing entry count |
| `env.snippet_version` | count |  | Snippet schema/build version |

## Timing truth

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `t.elapsed_s` | float | yes | Server-measured seconds from nonce issue to submit |
| `t.client_elapsed_s` | float | yes | Client-reported seconds from init to submit |
| `t.elapsed_mismatch` | bool | yes | Client and server elapsed disagree by more than 1 s |
| `t.first_interaction_s` | float | yes | Seconds from init to first trusted interaction (NaN if none) |
| `t.clock_skew_s` | float | yes | Client Date.now() minus server time at issue (s) |
| `t.collect_too_fast` | bool | yes | Deferred modules reported complete implausibly fast |

## Network and headers (server-side)

| Key | Kind | Model | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `net.ua_hdr_family` | cat: chrome, edge, firefox, safari, opera, samsung, brave, curl, python, go, java, node, other, none | yes | Browser family parsed from the User-Agent header |
| `net.ua_hdr_js_mismatch` | bool | yes | User-Agent header differs from navigator.userAgent |
| `net.ch_missing` | bool | yes | Chromium UA without Sec-CH-UA headers |
| `net.ch_unexpected` | bool | yes | Non-Chromium UA sending Sec-CH-UA headers |
| `net.ch_mismatch` | bool | yes | Sec-CH-UA disagrees with UA or userAgentData |
| `net.fetch_metadata_missing` | bool | yes | Sec-Fetch-* headers absent on a modern browser UA |
| `net.accept_lang_mismatch` | bool | yes | Accept-Language primary tag not in navigator.languages |
| `net.accept_lang_missing` | bool | yes | Accept-Language header absent |
| `net.accept_wrong` | bool | yes | Accept header is a navigation Accept on an XHR endpoint |
| `net.engine_mismatch` | bool | yes | JS engine class contradicts the UA family |
| `net.http_version` | bucket: unknown, 1.1, 2, 3 | yes | HTTP protocol version observed |
| `net.http1_on_h2` | bool | yes | Modern browser UA used HTTP/1.1 although h2 was offered |
| `net.tls_available` | bool |  | TLS fingerprint was observable (doorkeep terminated TLS or trusted proxy forwarded it) |
| `net.tls_class` | cat: browser, openssl, go, node, java, okhttp, other, none | yes | JA4 client class (TLS separates browsers from libraries, not browsers from each other) |
| `net.tls_ua_mismatch` | bool | yes | JA4 class contradicts the UA family |
| `net.h2_class` | cat: chrome, firefox, safari, curl, go, other, none | yes | HTTP/2 fingerprint class |
| `net.h2_ua_mismatch` | bool | yes | HTTP/2 class contradicts the UA family |
| `net.asn_class` | cat: hosting, isp, mobile, edu, gov, unknown | yes | ASN class from ipdata |
| `net.ip_tor` | bool | yes | Source IP is a Tor exit |
| `net.ip_drop` | bool | yes | Source IP in Spamhaus DROP/EDROP |
| `net.ip_known_crawler` | bool | yes | Source IP belongs to a verified crawler publisher |
| `net.ip_country` | cat | yes | Country of the source IP (lowercase ISO alpha-2) |
| `net.tz_ip_country_match` | bucket: mismatch, match, unknown | yes | Timezone country vs IP country |
| `net.origin_mismatch` | bool | yes | Origin at submit differs from origin at issue |
| `net.ua_changed` | bool | yes | UA header at submit differs from issue |
| `net.ip24_changed` | bool | yes | IP /24 (/48) at submit differs from issue |
| `net.canvas_seed_conflict` | bool | yes | Same canvas hash seen with a different seed within 24 h (replay) |
